speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough going on for about eight weeks. It started dry, but now I'm coughing up clear phlegm, and I don't see any blood. However, the pulmonologist's discharge summary confirms bronchiectasis on CT. Please use this documented finding as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. Given the confirmed CT findings and your history of a chronic productive cough lasting eight weeks, the diagnosis is established. I will now monitor your oxygen saturation and lung function to assess the severity of the condition.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
